stem: In mid-November 2025, Voltmarkt's returns rate by sale month shows 2.1% for October's sales and 6.8% for August's. What is the most likely reason October looks so much lower?

options.text: Many returns of October's sales have not arrived yet
August's rate also counts returns of July's sales
October's sales were higher, which lowers its returns rate
The webshop sold fewer items in October than in August
